biggest_catch: This is a limited-time doubled offer ending September 30, 2026 — after that the standing offer is $50 per referral. Your friend must register via the referral link, open a new checking account by the promotional deadline, and complete one of two qualifying activities (eStatements or $500+ direct deposit within 60 days).
catches: Offer ends September 30, 2026; standard bonus is $50 outside this promotion
Friend must register via the ReferLive referral link and open a new Everwise checking account by the promotional deadline
Friend must complete at least one qualifying activity within 60 days of account opening: enroll in eStatements or make at least one direct deposit totaling $500 or more
Referrer can receive up to $500 in Reward Cards per calendar year (10 referrals at the $50 rate)
Mastercard Digital Reward Cards are valid for six months and only redeemable at Internet, Mail Order, and Telephone merchants
Friend ineligible if they had an Everwise banking relationship in the last 12 months or are already members
